WIND_GAUGE.NAME: Wind gauge
WIND_GAUGE.DESCRIPTION: Turns the frequency of a wind sensor into the wind speed: average, 3 second gust, maximum and wind alarm

FREQUENCY.NAME: Frequency (F)
FREQUENCY.DESCRIPTION: Frequency of the wind sensor in Hz

MAXIMUM.NAME: Maximum (AvgMax)
MAXIMUM.DESCRIPTION: Highest gust in the averaging time

ALARM.NAME: Wind alarm (Wa)
ALARM.DESCRIPTION: 1 when a gust reaches the alarm speed, 0 when the gusts and the average are below 90 % of it again

AVERAGING_TIME.NAME: Averaging time (Avgt, min)
AVERAGING_TIME.DESCRIPTION: Time window of the average and the maximum

FACTOR.NAME: Factor (F)
FACTOR.DESCRIPTION: Speed per Hz from the data sheet of the sensor (e.g. km/h per Hz)

ALARM_SPEED.NAME: Wind alarm speed (W)
ALARM_SPEED.DESCRIPTION: Speed for the wind alarm, in the unit of the factor

ADD.NAME: Sum
ADD.DESCRIPTION: Sums the input values and provides the value as output (O = I1 + I2 + I3 + I4)

SUBTRACT.NAME: Subtraction
SUBTRACT.DESCRIPTION: Subtracts a value from the given inputs (O = - I1 - I2)

MULTIPLY.NAME: Multiplication
MULTIPLY.DESCRIPTION: Multiplies the input values and provides the value as output (O = I1 * I2)

MODULO.NAME: Modulo
MODULO.DESCRIPTION: Returns the remainder of I1 / I2 (O = I1 % I2)

OUTPUT1.DESCRIPTION: Output value as floating point number

TRIGGER.DESCRIPTION: Generates a new random number whenever a value is written to this input

MIN.DESCRIPTION: Lowest value of the random number

MAX.DESCRIPTION: Highest value of the random number

MINMAX.NAME: Min/Max/Average
MINMAX.DESCRIPTION: Smallest, largest and average value of the inputs that have a value

INPUT.DESCRIPTION: Input value, unlinked inputs are ignored

REACHED.DESCRIPTION: 1 while the count is at or above the limit

STEP.NAME: Step
STEP.DESCRIPTION: Value added or subtracted per pulse

LIMIT.NAME: Limit
LIMIT.DESCRIPTION: Count from which Q is 1, 0 = not used

FORMULA.NAME: Formula
FORMULA.DESCRIPTION: Calculates a formula over I1 to I4

INPUT.DESCRIPTION: Variable of the formula, 0 without a value

PARAM.NAME: Formula
PARAM.DESCRIPTION: e.g. (I1 + I2) / 2 or if(I1 > 25, 100, 0). Operators + - * / % ^, comparisons < <= > >= == != (1 or 0), && || !, functions abs, sign, min, max, round(x, digits), floor, ceil, sqrt, pow, exp, ln, log, sin, cos, tan, clamp(x, min, max), if(condition, then, else), constants pi and e. Decimal separator is the dot

SCALER.NAME: Scaler
SCALER.DESCRIPTION: Converts a value linearly from one range to another, e.g. 0-10 V to 0-100 %

IN_MIN.NAME: Input min
IN_MIN.DESCRIPTION: Input value that maps to output min

IN_MAX.NAME: Input max
IN_MAX.DESCRIPTION: Input value that maps to output max

LIMIT.NAME: Limit
LIMIT.DESCRIPTION: Keeps the output inside the output range

PID.NAME: PID controller
PID.DESCRIPTION: Controls an actual value to a setpoint, e.g. a heating valve. Calculated once per cycle; Kd = 0 gives a PI controller, a negative Kp reverses the direction (cooling)

ENABLE.DESCRIPTION: 0 sets the output to min and clears the integral, unlinked = enabled

OUTPUT.DESCRIPTION: Manipulated value between min and max

OFF.DESCRIPTION: 1 resets the output and locks the block until Off is 0 again

STEPPER.NAME: Stepper
STEPPER.DESCRIPTION: Every pulse changes the value by the step size between 0 and the maximum, then starts over

STEP_INPUT.DESCRIPTION: Pulse changes the value by one step

DOWN.NAME: Count down
DOWN.DESCRIPTION: Off = up (after the maximum back to 0), on = down (below 0 back to the maximum)

ANALOG_MEMORY.NAME: Analog memory
ANALOG_MEMORY.DESCRIPTION: Stores the input value on a pulse and holds it at the output

SET.DESCRIPTION: Pulse copies the value to the output

MIN_MAX_SINCE_RESET.NAME: MinMax since reset
MIN_MAX_SINCE_RESET.DESCRIPTION: Lowest and highest input value since the last reset

RESET.DESCRIPTION: Pulse sets minimum and maximum to the current value

ANALOG_LIMITER.NAME: Analog limiter (min/max)
ANALOG_LIMITER.DESCRIPTION: Limits the input value to a range

MOVING_AVERAGE.NAME: Moving average
MOVING_AVERAGE.DESCRIPTION: Samples the input every C seconds and outputs the average of the last N samples

RESET.DESCRIPTION: 1 turns the averaging off, the output follows the input

CYCLE.NAME: Polling cycle [s]
CYCLE.DESCRIPTION: Time between two samples, 0 = every received value is a sample

SELECTION_SWITCH_PLUS.NAME: Selection switch (+)
SELECTION_SWITCH_PLUS.DESCRIPTION: Every pulse on + raises the value by the step size, after the maximum it starts again at the minimum

PLUS.DESCRIPTION: Pulse raises the value, holding repeats

OFF.DESCRIPTION: 1 sets the default value and locks the block until Off is 0 again

REPEAT.NAME: Repetition rate [s]
REPEAT.DESCRIPTION: Holding + longer than 0.5 s changes the value in this interval, 0 = off (for buttons that send no release)

DEFAULT.NAME: Default value
DEFAULT.DESCRIPTION: Value at the start and after Off

SELECTION_SWITCH_PLUS_MINUS.NAME: Selection switch (+/-)
SELECTION_SWITCH_PLUS_MINUS.DESCRIPTION: Every pulse on + or - changes the value by the step size between minimum and maximum

PLUS.DESCRIPTION: Pulse raises the value, holding repeats

MINUS.DESCRIPTION: Pulse lowers the value, holding repeats

OFF.DESCRIPTION: 1 sets the default value and locks the block until Off is 0 again

REPEAT.NAME: Repetition rate [s]
REPEAT.DESCRIPTION: Holding + or - longer than 0.5 s changes the value in this interval, 0 = off (for buttons that send no release)

DEFAULT.NAME: Default value
DEFAULT.DESCRIPTION: Value at the start and after Off
